This could mean that the systems are under heavy load, possibly due to the Tomcats needing to handle more requests, which in turn leads to higher memory usage.

Alternatively, the disk I/O could be the culprit, but the logs don't show direct errors from the disks.

Since the Tomcat instances are downstream of the databases, if the databases are under strain, that could cause the Tomcats to stall, leading to memory issues.
